summary: Oil prices have risen to $91 per barrel following an Ansar Allah blockade of Saudi Arabian ports. US officials report that Donald Trump is expected to decide in the coming days whether to expand military operations against the Islamic Republic. Multiple reports indicate missile and drone activity targeting infrastructure and bases in the region.
key_points: Oil prices rose to $91 per barrel due to the blockade imposed by Ansar Allah on Saudi Arabian ports (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/379587).
Ansar Allah has issued warnings to shipping companies to avoid Saudi Arabian ports to prevent them from becoming targets (Source: @asafroz/51728).
US officials state Donald Trump is expected to decide in the coming days whether to expand military operations against the Islamic Republic (Source: @mamlekate/103958).
Sirens were activated in Bahrain and Kuwait following missile fire from Iran (Source: @New_security8200/202826).
A British maritime trade center reported an additional attack against a vessel near the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @asafroz/51718).
The Lebanese army has begun deploying troops in the southern town of Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh following Israeli forces' withdrawal (Source: @manniefabian/58819).
Reports indicate explosions occurred near the airbase in Bandar Abbas (Source: @VahidOnline/77344).
The IDF killed an Islamic Jihad operative, Taher Ahmad Salem Abd al-Wahed, in a strike in the central Gaza Strip (Source: @manniefabian/58815).

sections.executive_summary: Oil prices have reached $91 per barrel due to Ansar Allah's blockade of Saudi Arabian ports. US officials indicate Donald Trump will soon decide on the potential expansion of military operations against Iran. Regional tensions are rising with reports of missile fire from Iran triggering sirens in Kuwait and Bahrain.

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level is escalating due to the convergence of maritime blockades and potential US military expansion. Ansar Allah's targeting of Saudi shipping and the reported missile fire from Iran into Kuwait and Bahrain indicate a high risk of regional escalation. The IDF's continued strikes in Gaza and the pilot security zone in Lebanon suggest ongoing kinetic operations.
sections.regional_response: The US is considering expanded military operations against Iran, while the UN is engaging in diplomatic efforts in Syria. The Lebanese army is actively deploying in southern regions to manage the post-withdrawal environment. Saudi Arabia is facing economic pressure from maritime blockades in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of ballistic missiles from Fars Province and strikes near Bandar Abbas suggest active Iranian missile capabilities. The diversion of tankers from Saudi ports to Suez highlights the operational impact of Ansar Allah's maritime strategy. The IDF's targeting of specific Islamic Jihad commanders indicates a focus on degrading leadership in Gaza.
